shared_fingerprint_refresh_scope: Only fingerprints of changed shared scene parser, test manifest, planning documents and dependent report references updated; previous evidence and historical regression results retained. Full regression remains d4.8 work.
limitations: v7 parses and saves but unified execution remains explicitly gated until d4.7.
Migration accepts only settled off/ready/running states without pending transitions or opposed residual output; other historical states require another named migration.
Save structural validation and source-link contracts do not replace resource rebuilding, runtime replay or full d4 save-resume coverage in d4.7.
The linked fleet fixtures assemble d4.5 no-scene records with legacy non-propulsion scene fields; they are not d4 scene execution or golden results.
next_slice_requirements: Build explicit v7 named scenes and rebuild exact resources and runtime on load.
Consume per-ship one-shot hard commands atomically, then wire hard faults, direction interlock, opening time, actual interval and closing soft safety.
Validate v6 step payloads with source and resulting scene lineage, physical resource recomputation and stable boundary event order.
Cover same-boundary exit, command suppression, faults, explicit reset, emergency cut, reversal zero-release and continuous versus saved-reloaded replay before opening the execution gate.
